data.title: MUTATION HOT ZONE 🧬
data.statement:
Near the old reactor zones, PAT scans hybrid fauna against the pre-Severance genome baseline. 

A mutation is any position where the creature's strand [[M]] differs from the reference strand [[R]] (same length). PAT must locate the densest hot zone: the contiguous stretch of [[K]] bases holding the most mutations.

Output the <<maximum number>> of mutations found in any window of length [[K]].
data.constraints:
1 ≤ [[K]] ≤ length of [[R]] ≤ 99
[[R]] and [[M]] have the same length and contain only {{A}}, {{C}}, {{G}}, {{T}}.
data.stubGenerator:
read K:int
read R:string(99)
read M:string(99)
write maxMutations
data.inputDescription:
Line 1: An integer [[K]], the window length.
Line 2: A string [[R]], the reference strand.
Line 3: A string [[M]], the mutated strand.
data.outputDescription: Line 1: An integer — the most mutations contained in any window of [[K]] consecutive bases.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Near the old reactor zones, PAT scans hybrid fauna against the pre-Severance genome baseline.

A mutation is any position where the creature's strand M differs from the reference strand R (same length). PAT must locate the densest hot zone: the contiguous stretch of K bases holding the most mutations.

Output the maximum number of mutations found in any window of length K.
Input
Line 1: An integer K, the window length.
Line 2: A string R, the reference strand.
Line 3: A string M, the mutated strand.
Output
Line 1: An integer — the most mutations contained in any window of K consecutive bases.
Constraints
1 ≤ K ≤ length of R ≤ 99
R and M have the same length and contain only A, C, G, T.
Example
Input
2
ACGT
AGGT
Output
1
